items.title: Kering Q2 2026: Gucci cho thấy dấu hiệu khởi sắc nhờ các mẫu túi xách mới
items.summary: Vietnamese fashion trade coverage of Kering's Q2 2026 results, reporting Gucci's revenue decline slowed to 2% (from 8% in Q1), driven by strong US demand and the new Borsetto and Paparazzo handbag lines. Frames this as evidence of the Rinascimento turnaround plan taking hold, with local relevance since Kering is diversifying beyond Gucci via jewelry growth.

items.title: Inside Gucci's Generation Gucci Event in Manila
items.summary: Manila celebrity event coverage where Filipino personalities including Pia Wurtzbach-Jauncey, Brent Manalo, Kylie Verzosa, Michelle Dee and BJ Pascual wore looks from Demna's first Gucci Pre-Fall collection, styled as a local activation of the brand's post-Demna repositioning in the Philippine market.

items.title: Billkin Served Looks At Gucci's Spring/Summer 2026 Launch At Marina Bay Sands
items.summary: Coverage of Thai actor/singer Billkin appearing at the renovated Gucci Marina Bay Sands flagship for the Spring/Summer 2026 launch, noting Singapore was the only Southeast Asian stop chosen for Demna's debut La Famiglia collection rollout, underscoring the city's flagship status in the region.

items.title: Gucci opens newly renovated store in Singapore at Marina Bay Sands
items.summary: Trade coverage of the reopened, redesigned Marina Bay Sands boutique (warm wood-clad walls, horse murals, glass shelving replacing gold racks), part of the store-network refresh under Demna, positioned as Gucci's regional flagship investment even as Kering trims store count elsewhere in Asia.

items.title: Gucci names Aespa's Ningning as global ambassador
items.summary: Report on K-pop star Ningning (aespa) becoming a Gucci global brand ambassador, cited here for its continuing relevance to Southeast Asia's large K-pop fanbase (Vietnam, Thailand, Philippines, Indonesia), which drives ongoing regional SNS chatter around the appointment months later.

items.title: Fan account recirculating Billkin x Gucci Singapore event details
items.summary: Thai fan/entertainment-news account post recirculating details of Billkin's Gucci Spring/Summer 2026 Marina Bay Sands appearance, illustrating organic fan-driven amplification of the brand's Southeast Asian ambassador activity beyond official channels.

items.title: Thai consumer thread asking price of a Gucci bucket hat
items.summary: Pantip community thread where a Thai consumer asks other members how much a Gucci bucket hat retails for, with replies referencing celebrity endorsement (BTS Jin) context; typical of everyday price-comparison chatter rather than brand campaign discussion, useful as an organic community-sentiment signal. Exact post date could not be confirmed via fetch (site redirected); treated as recent based on search indexing but low confidence on freshness.

items.title: Kering Must Downsize, Reduce Gucci Exposure and Chase Synergies, CEO de Meo Says in Memo
items.summary: CEO Luca de Meo memo stating Gucci store count in Asia-Pacific has reached saturation (166 stores, the largest regional count globally) and roughly 40% of Kering's planned 2026 store closures will land in Asian markets, though the heaviest closures target South Korea/Japan/China rather than Southeast Asia specifically. Included as critical-angle context on the retrenchment shaping SEA store footprint planning, despite being outside the tightest freshness window.

items.title: Chinese 'Miss Gucci' who disrupted an AirAsia flight comes to KL, makes victory sign
items.summary: Viral Malaysian news story about a Chinese passenger nicknamed online 'Miss Gucci' (after shouting a Mandarin expletive referencing the brand name during a mid-flight altercation) who disrupted an AirAsia Chongqing-KL flight, then posted a defiant victory-sign video from Kuala Lumpur. Not a genuine brand story (coincidental nickname/slang use, not Gucci product or marketing), but included for transparency since it surfaced repeatedly in brand-adjacent searches and shows how the brand name circulates in unrelated regional viral content; excluded from sentiment weighting as brand-irrelevant.
